VERDICT: REJECT

The proposed solution does not support its answer of 24. It asserts the value without a computation, and I cannot verify it from memory. The Crowley–Goette–Nordström computation for the two nearly parallel $G_2$-structures on $N_{k,l}$ would have to be checked against the paper, and the solution does not show the eta-invariant calculation that would produce a specific number. The claim that the two invariants have equal absolute value with opposite signs is also asserted rather than derived. The identification of the two homogeneous structures is also shaky: the solution calls one of them the "3-Sasakian Einstein metric" without justification.

CONFIDENCE: 2
